character: Fast, flowing 4.3km Dutch circuit with banked corners (especially the final turn). High-downforce track — rhythm and commitment through the fast middle sector are key. Tricky braking zones with poor visual references.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/netherlands/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Tarzan/Arie Luyendyk naming well documented

corners.name: Tarzan
corners.technique: Brake at 75m mark (look for brown grass patch), hard braking to 3rd gear. Trail brake to apex
corners.trap: Multiple racing lines make this deceptive; easy to over-drive on cold tires

corners.name: Turn 2-3
corners.technique: T2 fast right-hander — lift off as left kerb disappears. T3: 50% brake to avoid left front lockup, 3rd gear. Early apex, run wide through middle, straighten early for throttle
corners.trap: Getting greedy at T2 entry makes T3 very tight; T3 left front lockup is common

corners.name: Turn 4-6
corners.technique: Full throttle through the sequence if car is set up correctly. Smooth steering inputs
corners.trap: Running over the T3 exit kerb destabilises the car for this section

corners.name: Turn 7
corners.technique: Hard braking, precise through the direction change
corners.trap: The exit kerbs are deceptive and can launch the car

corners.name: Turn 8
corners.technique: Very difficult to judge turn-in point. Trust your reference and commit
corners.trap: One of the trickiest corners on the calendar — misjudging turn-in is near-universal

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.technique: Hard braking, patience through the sequence. Exit feeds a short straight
corners.trap: Over-driving the first part compromises exit

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.technique: Hard braking, very late apex. Exit speed feeds the approach to the banked final turns
corners.trap: Early apex kills the run through the final sector

corners.name: Turn 13-14
corners.technique: T13 brake at ~45m, 4th gear 200 km/h. Avoid inside kerb. T14 follow the banking, full throttle
corners.trap: Touching T13 inside kerb affects the run; getting too high on T13 exit kerb
